notes.title: VR Version on the Horizon!
notes.notes: We've been doing some behind the scenes work and planning and it looks like we have a VR version of PROJECT AZRIEL on the horizon with additional content (with the update or soon after).  Our projected timetable is 6 months.   There are still some detials to work out before this path is final but the wind is in our sails at this point so we wanted to share the news with you.

notes.title: Update 2017 1214
notes.notes:
We uploaded a fix to a bug we thought we squashed until we watched larszua stream PROJECT AZRIEL on Twitch.  The video helped us to trouble shoot the problem and solve it.  We ran some tests and it appears the problem is no longer present. 

This bug could have been very frustrating for those that experienced it and that's why we handled as soon as we could.  The bug prevented going into the mini games that diminish your infection and replenish your health and ammo.

We also added a warning for anyone who may try to play the game without doing the training first.  

We're working hard on getting Player Preferences and Key Mapping and controller support out soon.  So look for those features in our next update.  

Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented doing Remote Targeting and the Bio-Agent Resistance Training.  


Modifications, Additions, and Enhancements:

Warning dialogue box that appears for those who try to play the campaign before completing the training. 
Minor visual improvement to the menu


Content that we’re currently working on:

Cave Scene
Foothills Scene
Bonus Scene for those that purchased PROJECT AZRIEL at the Walker Stalker convention


Enhancements that we're currently working on:

Zombie face animation improvements.
Additional interactive props and decal dressing in Scenes 1 and 2.
Integrate Performance Enhancement into the game startup options.
Add settings options in the Main Menu and Pause Menu. 
Key Mapping and Controller Support
Main Menu and Pause Menu visual fixes and enhancements


Known issues that we're currently working on:

On rare occasions the game may crash in the second scene on some machines. 
Zombie spawning inhibited in the last mission area in the 2nd scene on rare occasions. 


Thanks for your partnership and support. 

The PROJECT AZRIEL Team

notes.title: Update 2017 1125
notes.notes:
It’s been a ride since our release and we’re excited to see where it goes next.  We’ve got bug fixes and enhancements ready for you in our latest update along with more content coming around the corner.  

We had a ton of people try and buy PROJECT AZRIEL at the Walker Stalker convention in Atlanta at the end of October and we were surprised at how quickly people learned to do the brain training activities in the game.  We designed the training in the game to be robust but we didn’t have time for people to go through the training at the convention so we just quickly explained how things work in the game and everyone from avid gamers to occasional gamers picked up on it right away.  

We did a raffle for a PROJECT AZRIEL jacket with a custom title for the winner.  The winner was Gabriel! Congratulations!  We’ll have that jacket made for you soon and of course, we would love to have a pic of you in the jacket. 

We got a lot of great feedback on the game at the convention as well.  New bugs were found, compliments were given, and we got numerous feature requests.  We’ll make a survey and ask for feedback on which feature requests the community would like us to prioritize.  

Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug that caused some controls to not function.
Fixed a bug that could cause the Hero to float away while the game was paused. 
Fixed a bug that caused the zombies to fall excessively. 
Fixed a bug that caused the Hero to randomly teleport. 
Fixed bugs that caused some visual oddities in the Hero 1st and 3rd person views.  
Fixed a bug that prevented the Hero from reloading. 
Fixed a bug that removed the HUD overlay images if the game was paused in the second scene. 
Fixed a bug in the second scene that prevented the Hero from climbing on the roof of the metal and glass warehouse from a ladder. 
Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented doing Remote Targeting and the Bio-Agent Resistance Training.


Modifications, Additions, and Enhancements:

Added the ability to close the Remote Targeting and Bio-Agent Resistance Training reminder overlay screens.  Previously the player would have to wait for a countdown before the screen auto-closed. 
Added missed target feedback to the Bio-Agent Resistance Training.
Added and modified zombie animations. 
Added more attack types for zombies.
Added impact tracers to help identify projectile hit locations. 
Enhanced zombie AI to help improve movement trajectory. 
Minor optimization enhancements such as modifying or removing some particle systems.
Improved the smoothness of jumping. 
Improved Depth of Field visualization. 
Updated post-processing effects.
Removed the bloom effect from weapons targeting symbols to improve visibility.


Content that we’re currently working on:

Cave Scene
Foothills Scene
Bonus Scene for those that purchased PROJECT AZRIEL at the Walker Stalker convention


Enhancements that we're currently working on:

Zombie face animation improvements.
Additional interactive props and decal dressing in Scenes 1 and 2.
Integrate Performance Enhancement into the game startup options.
Add settings options in the Main Menu and Pause Menu. 
Main Menu and Pause Menu visual fixes and enhancements


Known issues that we're currently working on:

On rare occasions the game may crash in the second scene on some machines. 
Zombie spawning inhibited in the last mission area in the 2nd scene on rare occasions. 


Thanks for your partnership and support. 

The PROJECT AZRIEL Team

notes.title: Early Access Release Tomorrow October 20th.
notes.notes:
Thank you for joining us on this adventure! 

Tomorrow we will launch PROJECT AZRIEL Early Access here on Steam.  We’re excited and we’ve been working hard to make sure that PROJECT AZRIEL is the least boring brain trainer in the world.  We have a ton of improvements planned but the core brain training activities are spot on and will provide rigorous brain training.  

The science behind PROJECT AZRIEL is solid.  You can read all about it in our companion book Zombies Can Make You Think Better: How a Game Can Change Your Brain.  Download it free here: https://www.projectazriel.com/downloadbook20171013 

If you’re interested in doing a free IQ pre-test and post-test, then please see instructions on how to do so here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/669700/discussions/5/1484358860943155152/ 

You can post your results here:  http://steamcommunity.com/app/669700/discussions/5/1484358860943155152/ 

We LOVE constructive feedback and feature requests.  We may even have what you’re looking for on our road map.  We know that the more input we get from thoughtful players, then the better our brain training game will be.  Once you’ve had a chance to play the game for a bit, tell us what you’d like to work better or what features you’d like to see.  

You can view Frequently Asked Questions, ask questions, provide feedback and engage in dialogue here:  http://steamcommunity.com/app/669700/discussions/  

If brain training has been boring you to death, then the solution is here!

Thanks for your partnership and support.
